meta.name: Limetown 2019
meta.description: Lia Haddock, a journalist for American Public Radio, unravels the mystery behind the disappearance of over 300 people at a research community in Tennessee.

videos.title: I Have Heard the Future
videos.overview: American Public Radio journalist Lia Haddock reckons with the 15 year old mystery: What happened to the people of Limetown?

videos.title: Redacted
videos.overview: Lia embarks on the first interview in recorded history with a survivor from Limetown.

videos.title: Rake
videos.overview: Lia and Mark visit Rake, Wyoming in search of the next Limetown survivor, but they're not prepared for the horrors they find.

videos.title: Napoleon
videos.overview: The second known survivor from Limetown reveals the saga of animal testing in the community.

videos.title: Signals
videos.overview: Lia finds herself in a secret bunker in order to interview the mysterious financier behind Limetown.

videos.title: A Simple Life
videos.overview: Famed neuroscientist Max Finlayson divulges the purpose of the doomed research facility.

videos.title: Acceptable Loss
videos.overview: After an unexpected visit, Lia questions whether or not to continue the investigation.

videos.title: Scarecrow
videos.overview: Limetown survivor Deirdre Wells reveals what incited The Panic.

videos.title: Apples and Oranges
videos.overview: An unknown survivor sends Lia a disturbing video file with a promise that she has all the answers.

videos.title: Answers
videos.overview: Season Finale. Lia receives all the answers she’s been seeking.
